Now, average speed isn't just (6 + 3)/2 because the time spent at each speed is different. I remember that average speed is total distance divided by total time. So I need to calculate the time taken for each part and add them up.

Time taken to go out: distance divided by speed, so 12 km / 6 km/h = 2 hours. Time returning: 12 km / 3 km/h = 4 hours. Total time is 2 + 4 = 6 hours. Total distance is 24 km. So average speed is 24 km / 6 h = 4 km/h. Oh, so the suggested answer is correct. The answer is B.
